# Third-party ground texture

Asset: Aerial Grass Rock (1K Diffuse)
Author: Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven
Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_grass_rock
License: CC0 1.0 Universal
Legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode
Platform license: https://polyhaven.com/license

Original PNG bytes are unchanged. Runtime material adds a tint and repeats the map
using world triplanar projection at 6m intervals. No normal/roughness maps were supplied.
The original metadata, byte hashes and review evidence are in the repository's
art-library/assets/Textures/polyhaven-aerial-grass-rock/ directory.
CC0 does not require attribution; this record preserves provenance.
